headline: As of 2026-10-23: 23,659,277 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 46 of 50 states, D+12.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 23,659,277 early/mail ballots cast so far across 46 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+12.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (3,018,754), California (2,640,634), Florida (2,171,720).
